comments.body:
I don't think this is right. If I send you an invalid transaction, you validate it and you ban me. You still want to record that you've seen it, so you don't validate it again.

i.e. there's a difference between "seen" and "I have it". I believe "seen" may also mean it's in the queue of transactions about to be validated.
